policy: Ten new cases selected after v4 remediation. Reference labels fixed before engine execution. Reference locators are distinct from engine-side evidence locators. No production logic changed during scoring.

cases.reference_basis: 2026 umbrella review found efficacy signals but substantial methodological/clinical heterogeneity and only three high-quality reviews.
2026 meta-analysis found promising benefit but called for high-quality trials to address heterogeneity and establish dosing/duration.
Recent systematic/meta-analytic evidence supports metabolic effects but is not sufficient for unconditional therapeutic replacement; formulation/dose heterogeneity remains relevant.

cases.indication: Lower urinary tract symptoms due to benign prostatic enlargement
cases.reference_basis: 2023 Cochrane review found Serenoa alone provides little to no difference in urinary symptoms or quality of life.
2025 review describes psyllium husk as a gold-standard bowel regulator with therapeutic effects in constipation.
Updated meta-analysis links aristolochic-acid exposure to markedly increased urinary tract cancer risk.
Modern review emphasizes toxicological risks and development of PA-depleted topical—not oral—formulations.
2026 GRADE-assessed meta-analysis found significant benefit but very high heterogeneity across major outcomes.
Cochrane synthesis reports possible efficacy for selected ARIs but evidence is preparation/condition dependent and heterogeneous.
Efficacy evidence exists for anxiety, but clinically important hepatotoxicity concerns and disputed causality make expert benefit-risk review appropriate.
